guest.label: the listed token's own logo — drop it at brands/<brand>/guests/<slug>.svg (or .png) and pass --guest <slug>

eyebrow.label: the small mono line, e.g. NOW LISTED or NEW PAIR

name.label: the token or project name, as THEY write it — 12: the mark moved right and took the column with it, and a listing names a token (Aerodrome 9, Moonwell 8, Uniswap 7). Put the longer legal name nowhere; the ticker carries the rest

ticker.label: the ticker as it trades, e.g. $AERO — drawn in the brand accent

network.label: where it trades, e.g. BASE · UMBRAE DLMM

support.label: one line on what is now possible — never a claim about their token's value

about.label: one short line on what THEIR token IS — the ecosystem it backs, in plain words. Optional: a listing with no description renders without it. Never a value claim, never a price — what it is, not what it is worth

contract.label: the token's on-chain address, e.g. 0x0b3e3284…E24e7E1b (42 chars = the full address). VERIFY IT BEFORE IT SHIPS — a wrong address on a public listing is a scam by our hand. Optional: a listing without a verified address renders without the line
